stdout:
usage: browser run-script [-h] --tab-id TAB_ID (--script SCRIPT |
                          --script-file SCRIPT_FILE | --script-stdin)
                          [--arg-json ARG_JSON | --arg-file ARG_FILE]
                          [--output-file OUTPUT_FILE] [--overwrite]
                          [--dialog {accept,dismiss}]
                          [--prompt-text PROMPT_TEXT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tab-id TAB_ID       Opaque tab ID returned by list/open/attach.
  --script SCRIPT
  --script-file SCRIPT_FILE
  --script-stdin
  --arg-json ARG_JSON
  --arg-file ARG_FILE
  --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                        Workspace-relative artifact path.
  --overwrite
  --dialog {accept,dismiss}
                        Answer for a confirm/prompt/leave-page dialog the page
                        opens; without it the dialog is dismissed and the
                        command fails with DIALOG_DECISION_REQUIRED.
  --prompt-text PROMPT_TEXT
                        Text for an accepted prompt (default: the prompt's
                        default value).
